netlist:
* Spicey Electrons circuit at 20 C
.options rshunt=1e12 reltol=1e-3 method=gear
.temp 20
vam_B1 n1 B1_am 0
V_B1 B1_int 0 PWL(0 0 1e-06 9)
R_B1_in B1_am B1_int 0.1
vam_R1 n1 R1_am 0
R_R1 R1_am n2 330
vam_LED1 n2 LED1_am 0
D_LED1 LED1_am n3 LED_red
vam_Q1 n3 Q1_am 0
vam_Q1_p0 n4 Q1_p0 0
vam_Q1_p2 0 Q1_p2 0
Q_Q1 Q1_am Q1_p0 Q1_p2 2N3904
vam_R2 n1 R2_am 0
R_R2 R2_am n4 47000
vam_C1 n3 C1_am 0
C_C1 C1_am n5 1e-05
vam_Q2 n6 Q2_am 0
vam_Q2_p0 n5 Q2_p0 0
vam_Q2_p2 0 Q2_p2 0
Q_Q2 Q2_am Q2_p0 Q2_p2 2N3904
vam_R3 n1 R3_am 0
R_R3 R3_am n7 330
vam_LED2 n7 LED2_am 0
D_LED2 LED2_am n6 LED_green
vam_R4 n1 R4_am 0
R_R4 R4_am n5 56000
vam_C2 n4 C2_am 0
C_C2 C2_am n6 1e-05
.model LED_red D(IS=3.2850e-17 N=2.0 RS=2.0 EG=2.300 XTI=3 BV=5 IBV=10u CJO=20p TT=10n)
.model 2N3904 NPN(IS=6.734f XTI=3 EG=1.11 VAF=74.03 BF=416.4 NE=1.259 ISE=6.734f IKF=66.78m XTB=1.5 BR=.7371 NC=2 ISC=0 IKR=0 RC=1 CJC=3.638p MJC=.3085 VJC=.75 FC=.5 CJE=4.493p MJE=.2593 VJE=.75 TR=239.5n TF=301.2p ITF=.4 VTF=4 XTF=2 RB=10)
.model LED_green D(IS=9.9187e-20 N=2.0 RS=2.0 EG=2.600 XTI=3 BV=5 IBV=10u CJO=20p TT=10n)
.control
set filetype=binary
tran 0.005 5 0 0.005
write __OUT__ v(n1) v(n2) v(n3) v(n4) v(n5) v(n6) v(n7) i(vam_b1) i(vam_r1) i(vam_led1) i(vam_q1) i(vam_r2) i(vam_c1) i(vam_q2) i(vam_r3) i(vam_led2) i(vam_r4) i(vam_c2) i(vam_q1_p0) i(vam_q1_p2) i(vam_q2_p0) i(vam_q2_p2)
quit
.endc
.end
